- `hmh07-lua-follow1:138` (original lines 107-172, 107-172, 107-172, 107-172): Builds small/large equipment lists, edge arrows and three quick-item views. List-active/grid events refresh arrows; current/mid/top item predicates hide NONE IDs, and model links retain id/cycle/type validation. Parent states distinguish cycle-open, inventory-open, hidden preference and keyboard/mouse. Health realId notifications play CycleDown. It sets default focus, installs close, calls optional PostLoadFunc, then configures free-cursor/navigation and returns self.

- `hmh07-lua-follow1:139` (original lines 107-172, 107-172, 107-172, 107-172): Builds a cylinder-mapped horizontal compass with 50 direction widgets, yaw-derived text and two native item layers using180. The yaw callback rounds/negates/adds360/modulos360 only for non-nil values. Separate PC inventory and preference predicates hide it. Preserve the Hidden predicate's recovered missing final return: its final local assignment is not silently returned. State watchers, input events, close and optional PostLoadFunc precede returning self.

Four generic keyboard states and FullConsumed disabled/unavailable predicates call AlwaysFalse, WZ keyboard predicate uses input type plus ShowQuickInventoryPC, Hidden2 returns true. FullConsumed filters type != ammo, then requests WarzoneInventory datasource. Registers exact model/input callbacks and class close, optionally PostLoadFunc, then calls SetQuickConsumeFilter before returning self. State priority/native datasource dispatch and actual consumption remain external.
